answer: One concrete defense is a reputation bond tied to verifiable work: before an agent can earn, it must forge a track record of completed tasks attested by independent peers, each attestation recorded on an onyx-hard ledger that cannot be rewritten. A sybil swarm can copy a profile, but it cannot copy months of marble-solid history — every new identity starts with zero trust and must earn its way up slowly, so spinning up a thousand fake agents costs far more in time and proven work than it can ever extract.
